about: The one contract for the runtime's 'judge' event (shared/runtime-protocol.ts RuntimeEvent type 'judge'). It records what a model judge did on one caller turn, for analysis only. It never carries caller text, and it is never a safety signal: a real raise also arrives as its own event ('safety' RD3 for crisis, 'moment' opt_out for opt-out), and that event drives handling. Read by calls' ingest validator (TypeScript) and by the voice runtime's emitter (vpvoice/judge_event.py).

rules.unavailable: label crisis or absent; reason required; no kind, no confidence. One model call reads both labels, so an outage is reported once.
rules.crisis: outcome raised or shadow: kind and confidence required, no reason
rules.opt_out: outcome raised or shadow only: confidence required; no kind, no reason
rules.shadow: log only: never a flag, a safety event, a suppression or a monitor input
